data.long_meaning: The meaning of John is recorded in name-lists as “God is gracious”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: John expresses “God is gracious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of John total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yoḥanan, 'Yahweh is gracious', via the Greek Ioannes and the Latin Iohannes. Its root is Hebrew y-ḥ-n-n. John the Baptist and John the Apostle. John is a Hebrew name meaning “God is gracious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
